labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Previously progressed (radiological progression) on at least one approved systemic therapy for advanced melanoma
Uptake of [68Ga]VMT02 or [203Pb]VMT01 by PET or SPECT imaging observed in at least one melanoma tumor site
Subjects with an active, known, or suspected autoimmune disease

labels.note: Monotherapy arm fits if MC1R imaging is positive; her active immune colitis rules out the nivolumab-combination arm only.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Participants must not have received prior systemic therapy for unresectable or metastatic melanoma as described in the protocol.
Prior immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy other than anti-PD1/PD-L1 as described in the protocol

labels.note: First-line trial; she already had nivolumab plus relatlimab (anti-LAG-3) for metastatic disease.

labels.label: not_relevant
labels.note: Limited to gastric, colorectal, NSCLC and head and neck cancers; melanoma is not included.
